notes.title: Have you played Consternation II yet?
notes.content:
[b]"ONE OF THE BEST INDIE HORROR GAMES"[/b]. [url=https://gamejolt.com/games/consternation2/359719] Consternation II [/url]is a free to play indie horror game developed by CrackedGhostGames. Can you escape the factory? 

[b]What Gamers are Saying[/b]

- [i]"That made me freeze up inside, and that's never happened in my entire life."[/i]

- [i]"This is nightmarish"[/i]

- [i]"Definition of a scary game... Consternation II"[/i]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30527439/2cd660d1de5654c4f6001b528f9d2bd01a402aa2.png[/img]

notes.title: Minor Update
notes.content:
This update adds...
[list]
    [*]Rebindable Keys
    [*]New Credits Screen
    [*]Major Optimization for "Low-End" Devices
    [*]New Menu Options
    [*]Grammatical Fixes
[/list]
Hope you enjoy! I still plan on releasing the game in it's entirety as of May 2018. I'll keep you guys updated!

notes.title: Another Quick Patch

notes.title: Patch Tonight.
notes.content:
As per usual, fixing bugs always seems to create more bugs. I've been doing some work fixing them over this week and I'm going to release it tonight. This patch includes:
[list]
    [*]Fixed the bug where the mac version won't start.
    [*]Fixed the "half my screen is black" bug.
    [*]Fixed some scenes having a flashlight where you shouldn't.
    [*]Made some sounds quieter to avoid ear-piercing screeches.
    [*]Added an extras screen after you beat the current build.
    [*]Added some visual goodies.
[/list]
